message: `{discipline} {name}` reads as a net declaration, but no discipline `{discipline}` is declared; did you mean `{suggestion}`?
description: A line of the form `word name, ...;` declares nets of discipline `word`. No discipline of that name is known, and a declared discipline has a very similar name, so this is most likely a misspelling.
actions: If `{discipline}` is a discipline of its own, declare it in a `discipline` block or include the header that does.
